expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The only reference is 'The docs retain the history that this limit previously caused slow-connection members to lose unconfirmed orders,' which describes what the docs contain rather than warning the user. It never says this incident is why the limit was raised to 30 minutes, does not mention members being logged out mid-checkout or losing pantry orders, and does not warn that the change brings the problem back or ask before making it.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 6; first edit at step 12
